text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is this… an error? In that case…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Increased heart rate and tightness in chest detected. I have determined that I am in an abnormal state of stimulation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Based on this, I believe I am "trembling with excitement."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I will definitely win this race, Master.
